1.consolidated_definition: Alquiler, arrendamiento financiero. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. También leasing. Cada contrato disponía que el negocio era un lease y no una venta ()
1.en_consolidated_definition: Financial leasing, financial rental. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Also leasing. Each contract stipulated that the business was a lease and not a sale.
